Thing
=====

Thing does *things*. See the `docs`_ or `Read the Docs <https://thing.rtfd.io>`__.

.. _docs: https://thing.example.com/docs

Installation
------------

Install it with pip::

    $ pip install thing

Or from source:

.. code-block:: bash

   git clone https://example.com/thing.git
   cd thing && make install
